{"expiry":1794155236760,"value":{"tags":["auto care","auto joe","best sellers","car detailing","cordless","ionmax cordless system"],"collections":[],"product":{"id":7927809671323,"title":"Auto Joe 24-Volt* IONMAX Cordless Portable Air Compressor | W/ 2.0-Ah Battery + Charger","body_html":"

When the air is low - pump it up - and Go With Joe®!

Skip the trip to the gas station and reach for the powerful portable air compressor that fits in the palm of your hand with the 24V-AJC 24-Volt* Cordless Air Compressor from AUTO JOE®.

Compact and convenient for camping, or commuting - it’s the power-packed rechargeable pump that’s perfect anywhere power is at a premium -- like at the park, at the pool, or on the road. Keep tires at the perfect pressure, inflate a bike tire, pool float or sport ball in seconds. Simply set the PSI on the digital display and pull the trigger. The 24V-AJC-LTE automatically stops at your preset pressure.

Unlike bulky gas-powered or electric tools, AUTO JOE’s 24-Volt* cordless compressor employs the most advanced lithium-ion battery technology for no fade power, and peak performance under pressure! When the work is done, simply plug the battery in, power it up – and it’s recharged and ready for your next inflation project!


  • CORDLESS CONVENIENCE: 24V rechargeable air compressor — perfect for home, auto, and on-the-go
  • POWERFUL PERFORMANCE: Inflates up to 120 PSI with 40 PSI working pressure
  • AUTO SHUTOFF: Set desired PSI on the digital display — automatically stops when set pressure is reached
  • LIGHTWEIGHT + PORTABLE: Weighs just 2.18 lbs and includes a 15-inch hose for easy use anywhere
  • MULTI-PURPOSE: Great for tires, sports balls, pool floats, air mattresses, and more
  • IONMAX TECHNOLOGY: Advanced lithium-ion battery for no-fade power and peak performance
  • INCLUDES ACCESSORIES: Sport ball needle, Presta valve adapter, tapered adapter, and carrying case
